WHERE THINGS GO WRONG ralking Ana Bell Syntactic errors Common and easily caught Static semantic errors Some languages check for these before running program Can cause unpredictable behavior No linguistic errors, but different meaning than what programmer intended Program crashes, stops running. Program runs forever Program gives an answer, but it's wrong! 6.100L Lecture 1

PYTHON PROGRAMS alking: Ana Bell A program is a sequence of definitions and commands.
